subtitle: Europe's fastest-processing residency-by-investment route — combining one of the continent's lowest entry thresholds with access to the Eurozone's third-largest economy.
stat2Desc: One of the lowest investment thresholds
stat3Desc: Economy in the Eurozone — stable & diversified
section1Body: Italy offers an exceptional quality of life, from the Alps to the Amalfi Coast, with world-class cuisine, climate, healthcare and education.
section2Body: As the 3rd largest economy in the Eurozone, Italy provides stability and access to the entire EU market.
section3Body: Italy offers attractive tax regimes for new residents, including the Flat Tax regime for high-net-worth individuals on foreign income.
section4Body: Applicants receive pre-approval before completing the investment, ensuring no risk of committing funds before confirmation.
benefit1: Visa-free travel across the Schengen Area
benefit2: Right to live and work in Italy
